However, 'Accurately estimate' is a valid individual goal. The reconstruction is a subset of the full intent (it misses the 'why' but captures the 'how'). The project description explicitly mentions 'anonymous pointing' and 'elicit productive conversations', which implies that estimates are submitted independently and not immediately visible to others to prevent bias. llg_001 covers the selection of a specific numerical value from estimation cards, which is the core action of estimating. llg_002 covers the submission of this value to the system, explicitly including the constraint of 'without immediate revelation to others', which aligns with the 'anonymous pointing' mechanism described in the project overview. high_level_associated.description: Agile Team Members aim to provide estimates without influence from others, leveraging anonymous pointing to ensure independent judgment and prevent anchoring bias.
